signatures.description: Implement a linear-scan register allocator that supports live-range splitting rather than spilling whole ranges: when a range cannot get a register, split it at the next use position of the evicted interval and at hot-loop backedges, requeueing the remainder. The allocator must keep the intervals sorted under insertions from splitting and must guarantee no interval is split more than a bounded number of times to ensure termination. Correctness is checked by validating that every read sees the last value written along all paths, including across split boundaries and phi-free loop joins.
